## sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

**Breaking change:** The `name` field on `/v2/users` has been split into `first_name` and `last_name`. Update any clients or integrations that read or write `name` before upgrading — requests still sending `name` will be rejected.

**New:** A `--incremental` flag is now available, letting you run pipelines that only process new or changed records instead of full syncs — faster runs and lower load on source systems.

**Performance:** Parquet writes are up to 40% faster, thanks to optimized batching and reduced memory copies in the write path. No configuration changes needed to benefit.

We recommend testing against a staging environment before upgrading production pipelines, given the `/v2/users` schema change. See the migration guide for field-mapping details.
